caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a hinged lid that is open at an angle. The exterior of the box and the inside of the lid are illustrated in a brown woodgrain color. Inside the box, there are several rows of slender, uniformly shaped dark objects arranged parallel to each other, divided into two sections by a central divider. On the right side of the interior, there is a shorter row of upright items, possibly metallic, protruding in parallel in a lighter-colored wooden holder within the box. Two thin lines, possibly cords or metal supports, extend from the left and right sides of the bottom half of the box to the inside of the lid, holding it open. In the upper center of the box’s interior lid, some curved white lettering is visible. The background is plain and off-white. The artist's signature, "Alex Bush," is present in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Dulcimer
